messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
What is the maximum amount of the penalty applicable in Italy, on 1 February 2027, to a manufacturer infringing Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

response.text: Qual è l'importo massimo della sanzione applicabile in Italia, al 1 febbraio 2027, a un fabbricante che violi il Regolamento (UE) 2023/1230?
